notes: Regression guard: `seriesKey` (added for `previous-superset` candidacy) must never widen what `previous-comparable` itself treats as comparable. `W` (selector `[]`) and `N1`/`N2` (selector `['src']`) are all in the same series, but a plain `compare` with no baseline spec still uses `previous-comparable`'s full stream-key match (selector included) and picks the same-selector `N1`, not the wider `W`. `transitions.out_of_scope` staying undefined is the observational proof that no `selector-subset` narrowing ever entered this comparison -- `previous-comparable` never widened its own candidate scope by the series-key addition.
